Ammunition. Damage 1-4 (small or man-sized), 1-2 (large).

A large rounded tip instead of a point, for birds and small creatures a normal head would cut in half. The text says 1-2 damage to any size; Table 4 gives 1-4/1-2.

Armor class adjustments (Dragon #146; apply by hand in place of the bow's): daikyu AC 2 -2, AC 3 -1, AC 4 0, AC 5 0, AC 6 0, AC 7 +1, AC 8 +1, AC 9 +2, AC 10 +3; hankyu AC 2 -4, AC 3 -3, AC 4 -2, AC 5 -2, AC 6 -1, AC 7 0, AC 8 0, AC 9 +1, AC 10 +1. Short composite bow: the hankyu figures -1; short bow: -2.
